# MH-29 — Detail the route

**Business value:** 850

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As a hiker
I want to specify my detailed prospective path on a map
So that rescuers can understand where I planned to travel

## Notes

The hiker should be able to upload a GPX file and see it shown on a map.
